knowledge:
- key_parameters: geneModel=A GRangesList object containing gene model coordinates ;; targetGene=A character string specifying the target gene name ;; from=Numeric coordinate to set the start of the plot window ;; to=Numeric coordinate to set the end of the plot window ;; extend.left=Numeric value to extend the plot window upstream ;; extend.right=Numeric value to extend the plot window downstream ;; showGuideLabels=Logical indicating whether to display individual gRNA labels ;; pamSiteOnly=Logical indicating whether to plot only the PAM site instead of the full protospacer and PAM ;; onTargetScore=Character string specifying a GuideSet metadata column to color spacers by score ;; bsgenome=A BSgenome object to display nucleotide sequences ;; annotations=A named list of GRanges objects to plot as custom annotation tracks ;; includeSNPTrack=Logical indicating whether to include a track for SNPs overlapping the gRNAs ;; guideStacking=Character string (e.g., "dense") to control guide layout ;; gcWindow=Numeric value specifying the window size for plotting percent GC content in plotMultipleGuideSets
- alternatives: None mentioned; designed to work directly with GuideSet objects from crisprDesign and gene models from Ensembl/UCSC.
- when_to_use: Use when designing CRISPR gRNAs (for knockouts, base editing, or CRISPRa/i) to visually inspect guide locations, assess isoform coverage, check for overlaps with SNPs or repeat elements, and align guides with functional genomic annotations like CAGE peaks or DNase I hypersensitivity sites.
- pitfalls: The default plot window is determined by the ranges of the input GuideSet, which may cut off parts of the target gene unless manually adjusted using from, to, extend.left, or extend.right. Plotting too many guides can crowd the plot; use showGuideLabels=FALSE or filter the GuideSet first. The SNP track is only plotted if at least one guide in the input GuideSet overlaps a SNP; filtering out SNP-overlapping guides will automatically remove the track. Large plots with many isoforms or tracks may exceed default graphical device dimensions and throw an error, requiring manual adjustment of the device height/width.

workflows.name: single_guideset_visualization_and_filtering
workflows.intent: Visualize, annotate, and filter a single GuideSet targeting a gene of interest to select optimal gRNAs.
input: GRanges (genomic annotations such as repeats, CAGE peaks, or DNase sites)
workflows.stages: 1. Plot initial candidate gRNAs against the gene model to inspect isoform coverage. ;; 2. Adjust the genomic window to zoom in on specific exons or regions of interest. ;; 3. Add repeat and SNP annotation tracks to identify problematic guides. ;; 4. Filter out guides overlapping repeats or SNPs. ;; 5. Add functional annotations (CAGE, DNase) and filter guides overlapping active regions. ;; 6. Visualize final selected guides with on-target scores or nucleotide-level resolution.
workflows.code:
plotGuideSet(krasGuideSet[1:4],
             geneModel=krasGeneModel,
             targetGene="KRAS")

from <- min(start(krasGeneModel$transcripts))
to <- max(end(krasGeneModel$transcripts))
plotGuideSet(krasGuideSet[1:4],
             geneModel=krasGeneModel,
             targetGene="KRAS",
             from=from,
             to=to,
             extend.left=1000,
             extend.right=1000)

plotGuideSet(krasGuideSet,
             geneModel=krasGeneModel,
             targetGene="KRAS",
             showGuideLabels=FALSE,
             from=from,
             to=to,
             extend.left=1000,
             extend.right=1000)

targetExon <- queryTxObject(krasGeneModel,
                            featureType="cds",
                            queryColumn="exon_id",
                            queryValue="ENSE00000936617")
targetExon <- unique(targetExon)
from <- start(targetExon)
to <- end(targetExon)
plotGuideSet(krasGuideSet,
             geneModel=krasGeneModel,
             targetGene="KRAS",
             from=from,
             to=to,
             extend.left=20,
             extend.right=20)

plotGuideSet(krasGuideSet,
             geneModel=krasGeneModel,
             targetGene="KRAS",
             from=from,
             to=to,
             extend.left=20,
             extend.right=20,
             pamSiteOnly=TRUE)

selectedGuides <- c("spacer_80", "spacer_84", "spacer_88", "spacer_92",
                    "spacer_96", "spacer_100", "spacer_104", "spacer_108",
                    "spacer_112")
candidateGuides <- krasGuideSet[selectedGuides]
plotGuideSet(candidateGuides,
             geneModel=krasGeneModel,
             targetGene="KRAS",
             onTargetScore="score_deephf")

plotGuideSet(gpr21GuideSet,
             geneModel=gpr21GeneModel,
             targetGene="GPR21",
             bsgenome=BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
             margin=0.3)

from <- min(start(mmp7GuideSet))
to <- max(end(mmp7GuideSet))
plotGuideSet(mmp7GuideSet,
             geneModel=mmp7GeneModel,
             targetGene="MMP7",
             guideStacking="dense",
             annotations=list(Repeats=repeats),
             pamSiteOnly=TRUE,
             from=from,
             to=to,
             extend.left=600,
             extend.right=100,
             includeSNPTrack=TRUE)

filteredGuideSet <- crisprDesign::removeRepeats(mmp7GuideSet,
                                                gr.repeats=repeats)
filteredGuideSet <- filteredGuideSet[!filteredGuideSet$hasSNP]
plotGuideSet(filteredGuideSet,
             geneModel=mmp7GeneModel,
             targetGene="MMP7",
             guideStacking="dense",
             annotations=list(Repeats=repeats),
             pamSiteOnly=TRUE,
             from=from,
             to=to,
             extend.left=600,
             extend.right=100,
             includeSNPTrack=TRUE)

plotGuideSet(filteredGuideSet,
             geneModel=mmp7GeneModel,
             targetGene="MMP7",
             guideStacking="dense",
             annotations=list(CAGE=cage, DNase=dnase),
             pamSiteOnly=TRUE,
             from=from,
             to=to,
             extend.left=600,
             extend.right=100)

overlaps <- findOverlaps(filteredGuideSet, dnase, ignore.strand=TRUE)
finalGuideSet <- filteredGuideSet[queryHits(overlaps)]
plotGuideSet(finalGuideSet,
             geneModel=mmp7GeneModel,
             targetGene="MMP7",
             guideStacking="dense",
             annotations=list(CAGE=cage, DNase=dnase),
             pamSiteOnly=TRUE,
             margin=0.4)

workflows.name: compare_multiple_guidesets
workflows.intent: Compare gRNA target distributions and PAM sites across different nucleases for the same genomic region.
input: List of GuideSet objects (representing different nucleases)
workflows.stages: 1. Load GuideSets for different nucleases (e.g., SpCas9 and AsCas12a) targeting the same region. ;; 2. Plot and compare the GuideSets side-by-side, including a GC content track.
workflows.code:
plotMultipleGuideSets(list(SpCas9=cas9GuideSet, AsCas12a=cas12aGuideSet),
                      geneModel=ltn1GeneModel,
                      targetGene="LTN1",
                      bsgenome=BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
                      margin=0.2,
                      gcWindow=10)
